summary: cmd_list --overdue now evaluates today() in its own try (keeping the invalid TASKLIST_TODAY error), then checks each open task's stored due with core.parse_date and fails with 'error: task <id> has an invalid due date: <due>' (exit 2) before calling core.overdue_tasks. This also removes the KeyError from os.environ[...] when TASKLIST_TODAY was unset.
assumptions: Only open tasks are checked, matching overdue_tasks, which ignores done tasks.
If TASKLIST_TODAY is invalid it is reported first, regardless of bad task dues.
The first malformed task in file order is reported.
